author: Bijan Mousavi
title: Admission tied to completed staged checks
why: A readable report cannot authorize a commit unless its exact staged payload actually passed the required checks.
what: Add preparation, concurrent bounded gate execution, receipt-based report generation and staged triplet/trailer freshness checks.
how: Freeze parent and payload, collect every process result, generate twice from real completed receipts, then compare the staged bytes and commit trailer. Unknown application scope includes both adapter builds.
preserved: Original application commands, source, lock, assets, adapters and deployment are unchanged. Preparation and finalization never stage or commit automatically. Prior report identities stay intact.
risk: Local receipts are contributor evidence and cannot replace independent CI. TeX has no shell escape but requires an isolated secret-free environment for untrusted contributions.
limitations: 13 developer, 57 report and 20 verification tests passed on the frozen index. This tooling-only candidate required no application build. No browser, viewer, platform or remote CI claim.
rollback: Revert admission tools and aliases together in a new reported commit. Preserve failed attempt evidence and the existing export/report utilities.
